purpose: Let a surplus universal worker propose concrete useful work without filler or duplicate substantive execution.

fingerprint.normalization: NFKD accent folding + lowercase + slash normalization + punctuation/whitespace normalization; acceptance is unique sorted normalized values
fingerprint.target_semantics: target may be a stable string or structured object; when owner/scope/privacy/output materially distinguishes work, encode those discriminators inside target so the four-field identity does not false-merge them

proposal_gate: at least one durable evidence ref exists
at least one evidence-backed useful-value signal exists
obvious private credential payload shapes are rejected
proposal cannot claim READY, Current, Human Accepted or Served authority

pin_contract.collision: loser must not overwrite; choose another concrete problem or re-enter allocation

proposal_contract.immutability: source proposal and pin are append-only evidence; later disposition is separate
proposal_contract.scope: candidate scopes are planning hints, never execution authority

preserved_prior_rules: Do not deduplicate solely by title or text similarity.
Material differences in root/target/problem/acceptance remain separate.
When owner/scope/privacy/output differences are material, they must be represented inside structured target before fingerprinting.
No proposal spam merely to keep a worker busy.
Duplicate source lineage is preserved even when later Planner/Steward clustering occurs.
